review:
Zeus on the Trueways engine, holding a lightning-bolt Collect symbol, with reels that shift constantly.

In free spins, wilds land with 2x, 3x or 5x multipliers, and every one adds to the total, so wins keep growing through the round. Coin Respin has three jackpots, with Zeus collecting coin values. Very high volatility, 5,000x max and 96.7% RTP. Same engine as Wild West Trueways and Elvis Frog Trueways.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
